remarks: Live with the luxury and ease you deserve in this move-in ready home offering first-class designer space, function and energy-saving features. Presented in immaculate condition, you'll enjoy light hardwood flooring throughout, an easy flow of entertainment rooms and a fab chef's kitchen open to it all. Sliders from the living/dining area welcome the outdoor space, complete with a privately situated deck (maintenance free) overlooking the level + fenced back lawn. The primary bedroom boasts a premier walk-in closet customized for a fashion queen! Two renovated full baths, finished lower level, central a/c, economical gas heat, extra insulation and desirable, convenient location make this pet-friendly property the home you've been looking for. Available furnished or unfurnished.
